runtime.transitiveDependencyLimit: Entry and binary identities are bound; supplied transitive installation must remain unchanged.

scope.selection: Every completed opaque reviewer bundle whose context.task.mode is implementation; both variants and all repetitions, including failed captures with existing artifacts. List absent/missing/failed observations explicitly.
scope.reference: Capture original reference.html once over the same HTTP setup; retain the original supplied reference PNG as immutable authority.
scope.schedule: Uniform supplement to the existing fixed comparison; no model invocation, retries, replacements, case selection by performance, rubric changes or variant mapping reads.
scope.output: Fresh separate directory per artifact bundle; preserve every original file:// observation and raw artifact.
scope.review: Independent review of actual browser images and evidence; HTTP transport does not award a quality score or establish adoption.

measurementPreservation: Exact frozen measurement block, browser binary, viewports and interaction sequence. Only entry transport and network confinement differ.

transport.server: 127.0.0.1 port 0, GET/HEAD only, regular-file immutable snapshot, bounded payload, no forwarding
transport.network: Exact artifact origin only; external page requests aborted, deny-all local proxy for worker/WebSocket traffic, no unproxied WebRTC UDP

demonstration.variant: Not inspected; operator mapping is not read.
